body:
feat(papercraft): Phase 1c-client -- render real server rotation on falling fragments

apps/client now renders the real server-authoritative fragment spin Phase 1c (S206-50)
already broadcasts, closing the gap that phase explicitly deferred.

- packages/common/papercraft_protocol.h: renamed and re-signatured the shared lookup
  pc_falling_lookup_y (returned only *out_y) to pc_falling_lookup, which now writes the
  whole matching PcFallingFragment (y and rotation_deg) to one out-pointer instead of
  forcing a second near-duplicate scan for the new field.
- apps/client/src/main.c: update_and_draw_debris uses the new lookup and applies a real,
  hand-computed Y-axis rotation to each debris piece's 4 local_corners -- rotated in the
  XZ plane around their own real local centroid (average of the 4 corners, correct
  regardless of pre-existing jitter), by the real matched rotation_deg, leaving y
  untouched. A piece with no real match keeps its unrotated corners, the same
  zero-behavior-change fallback pattern Phase 1b's own Y-override established. Rotation
  is applied by hand rather than a GL matrix stack, since a stack push/pop per piece
  would force splitting the existing single glBegin/glEnd debris batch into one draw
  call per piece.
- packages/common/papercraft_falling_test.c: updated to the new pc_falling_lookup
  signature, preserving all 8 original assertions and adding 3 new ones covering
  rotation_deg (11 total, all pass).

Verified:
- Hand-traced the rotation math with a concrete numeric example: a unit-ish quad
  centered at local (1.25, 1.25) rotated 90 degrees around its own centroid maps each
  corner exactly onto its neighboring corner's original position -- confirmed by direct
  computation, not just trusting the formula.
- Raw-gcc compile-checked apps/client/src/main.c, apps/server/src/main.c, and
  apps/mapeditor/src/main.c clean (server/mapeditor untouched, spot-checked per habit).
  Fixed a real -Wmaybe-uninitialized warning on real_match.rotation_deg by zero-init at
  declaration.
- bazel clean && bazel build //... && bazel test //...: 27 targets build, 12/12 tests
  pass, including the extended papercraft_falling_test.
- No live graphical Xvfb session available in this environment (no known real test IDUNA
  user for full login automation) -- same honest client-verification scope limit Phase
  1b's own rendering integration already carried.

NORTHSTAR.md: added a new "Phase 1c-client" section documenting this, closing the gap
Phase 1c's own section explicitly named as deferred.
